description.zh: 1.6.9：展示百分数并存储小数。precision={4} 时，0.0126 显示为 1.26%；onChange 返回小数存储值。
description.en: In 1.6.9, percentages are displayed while decimal values are stored. With precision={4}, 0.0126 is displayed as 1.26%; onChange returns the stored decimal value.

description.zh: 1.6.9：绑定 type='percentage' 的 DataSet 字段，展示单值、范围和多值。初始值 0.125 显示为 12.5%；补零和语言小数分隔符通过局部 ConfigProvider 配置。
description.en: In 1.6.9, bind DataSet fields with type='percentage' for single values, ranges and multiple values. The initial value 0.125 displays as 12.5%; zero filling and locale decimal separators are configured through a local ConfigProvider.
